services.name: balloon class
services.story: The main story: a $140 balloon class (2½ hours, one to one). A $40 deposit now, and the $100 rest at the studio.

services.name: balloon lesson
services.story: A $35 balloon lesson. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee. Alex pays at the studio.

services.name: balloon lesson
services.story: A $35 balloon lesson for a returning student. Nothing is taken: a YES books it.

services.name: private balloon lesson
services.story: A $55 private lesson (60 minutes), paid in full when booking.

services.name: Custom character plan
services.story: A custom character plan for a party routine, priced from the show list at $90. Booked once Sam OKs it, and paid at the studio.

services.name: Birthday party clown
services.story: The main story: a 2-hour birthday party, quoted from Alex's plan at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract. A $160 deposit holds the date, and the $480 rest goes on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Birthday party clown
services.story: A company party, quoted from the plan at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract, a $160 deposit holds the date, and the rest, with any overtime, goes on the bill after.

services.name: Kids' party
services.story: A $150 kids' party (2 hours). A $40 deposit now, and the $110 rest on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Kids' party
services.story: The $150 kids' party, paid in full when booking.

questions_before_times: The kind of event: a birthday, a company party, a wedding, a restaurant show or a small event
The date, and the start and end time
The venue's name and town (for the travel fee), and indoors, outdoors or both
About how many guests, and the ages of the children (it sets the show)
Add-ons: a second act, a magic table, an extra hour
At the studio: the class or lesson and the age of the student
safety_stop: Someone hurt, a fire, or a fight at the party right now
license: None for clown work or balloon lessons in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.
staff_skills: ["Kids' parties (leads only)","Birthday and company parties","Weddings (leads only)","Balloon work","Lessons"]
messages_never: Gate codes, access notes, a child's name, age and details, and family notes stay on the secure page. The show form stays on the form. Texts to the clown carry none of them either.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
